# The Chef & The Dish

> > Virtual cooking classes connecting home cooks with professional chefs from around the world via Zoom and Skype

The Chef & The Dish offers live, interactive cooking classes featuring authentic international cuisine from countries including Thailand, India, Mexico, Italy, Spain, Peru, and beyond. Classes are available as group sessions for team building, private lessons for date nights, and beginner-friendly formats accessible from any location.

## Key Topics

- Virtual cooking classes
- International cuisine
- Team building cooking events
- Beginner-friendly classes
- Thai cooking
- Indian cooking
- Mexican cooking
- Italian cooking

- Zoom cooking classes
- Group cooking classes
- Private cooking lessons
- Date night activities
- Online culinary education

## Popular Group Cooking Classes

- [How to Cook Massaman Curry & Pad Thai](https://www.thechefandthedish.com/group-class/massaman-curry-and-pad-thai): Virtual Thai cooking class with Chef Joy: Massaman Curry & Pad Thai
- [How to Cook Butter Chicken](https://www.thechefandthedish.com/group-class/butter-chicken): Indian Butter Chicken cooking class with raita and basmati rice
- [Group Cooking Class: Chana Masala](https://www.thechefandthedish.com/group-class/chana-masala): Indian vegetarian cooking class: Chana Masala with Chef Shoubham
- [Group Cooking Class: Gumbo](https://www.thechefandthedish.com/group-class/gumbo): New Orleans Gumbo team building cooking class
- [Group Cooking Class: Empanadas](https://www.thechefandthedish.com/group-class/empanadas): Peruvian empanadas team building class with Chef Lucia
- [How to Cook Sancocho](https://www.thechefandthedish.com/group-class/sancocho): Dominican Sancocho cooking class with Chef Alberto

## International Cuisine Classes

- [How to Cook Stuffed Meatballs with Salsa Verde](https://www.thechefandthedish.com/group-class/colima-meatballs): Mexican Colima-style meatballs class with Chef Andres
- [How to Cook Visit San Sebastian](https://www.thechefandthedish.com/group-class/visit-san-sebastian): Spanish pinchos cooking class featuring San Sebastian cuisine
- [How to Cook Street Food](https://www.thechefandthedish.com/group-class/street-food): Italian street food class: Frittata di Pasta & Suppli di Riso
- [How to Cook Seafood & Corn Chowder](https://www.thechefandthedish.com/group-class/seafood-and-corn-chowder): New England chowder team building class with Chef Ted
- [Group Cooking Class: Apples, Pickling & The Ultimate Grilled Cheese](https://www.thechefandthedish.com/group-class/the-ultimate-grilled-cheese): Team building class: gourmet grilled cheese with Chef Ted
